beats.text: The novel asks how much that control decides before its categories have been justified.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Partners, children, doctors, and Echoes bring different needs to the promise of more time.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The story keeps those claims personal without settling consciousness through a convenient definition.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Bowl That Listened, then follow the unexpected recording into the clinic's claims.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Attend to who consents, who can refuse, and who controls the conditions of speaking.

beats.text: Read the novel to question what a likeness may ask of the people who remain.
